scripts.dev: bun run db:up && bun run --parallel dev:backend dev:frontend
scripts.build:frontend:dev: bun --env-file=.env.development.local x vite build --mode development --config frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:frontend:prod: bun --env-file=.env x vite build --mode production --config frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.generate: sync-engine artifacts pin && sync-engine artifacts pin --config generated.reader.config.ts
scripts.check:dev: bun run check:static && bun run build:frontend:dev && bun run test
scripts.check:prod: bun run check:static && bun run build:frontend:prod
scripts.check:static: bun run check:design && bun run check:framework && bun run check:artifacts && bun run typecheck
scripts.check:artifacts: sync-engine artifacts check && sync-engine artifacts check --config generated.reader.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:backend && bun run typecheck:frontend
scripts.db:up: podman compose --env-file .env.development.local -p wikiplotter-dev up -d mongo && bun --env-file=.env.development.local scripts/init-mongo-replica.ts
scripts.db:shell: podman compose --env-file .env.development.local -p wikiplotter-dev exec mongo mongosh -u "$MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME" -p "$MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD" --authenticationDatabase admin
